name: RC-B10-0143/2026 – After § 5 – Am 3/REV
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on four years of Russia’s war of aggression against Ukraine and European contributions to a just peace and sustained security for Ukraine
part_text: 5a. Regrets the fact that EU has prioritised a military solution and NATO alignment over an autonomous and sustained diplomatic, despite the war taking place on its continent and having direct consequences for EU citizens; calls for the EU institutions to actively support and facilitate a peace process, drawing necessary lessons from previous experiences so as not to repeat past mistakes; calls for the EU to actively work towards a durable and comprehensive peace agreement addressing the root causes of the conflict, grounded in the principles of the Helsinki Final Act and of the UN Charter, including collective security, military restraint, disarmament commitments, transparency and mechanisms to avoid further escalation;
